review.scope: Whole nonliving peptone/tryptone-free complete basal cell-culture medium produced by dry roller compaction of actual homogeneous prepared powder, with full upstream premix, utility, hydraulic-fluid, filter, container and waste interfaces.
review.source_and_method: Root independently extracted actual Merck2022 eight-page original and EPO T1318/18 complete original; viewed actual MerckPDF2 Figure1 roller/plate/mill/vibratory-sieve/fines-return topology andPDF4 Figure5 caption. Figure5 amino-acid/vitamin/trace-element recovery is feed, not universal basal-medium assay or proof of chemical invariance. Root read EPO claim and side-reaction reasoning: peptone/tryptone-free claim is explicit; avoidance of wet/heating side reactions lacked adequate comparative support. Merck brief and GEN article are producer-related sources, not independent LCIs. No recipe, efficiency, emission, biological performance or benefit default. Actual complete premix/utility producers are required whether purchased or owned, not hidden compounding. Root clarified existing gross whole-air withdrawal and complete exhaust/return/carrier/humidity ledgers versus actual incremental dust/water emissions in EN/ZH, retaining21 card identities. Normal double sync and finite check passed.
review.native_and_classification: Full state100 BiologicalMedium ProductMass/kg whole prepared medium at plant has no hard composition/route/form/geography restriction; actual complete nonliving basal prepared medium fits, rather than a live culture, nutrient component or starter proxy. Two material-stage bindings and exact AC property/unit chain read completely. CurrentCPC35440 explicitly includes prepared media. Actual matrix/provider qualification and ordinary specific unbound identities remain study obligations, not scientific approval.
review.event_stock_accounting: Original unique first acceptance Q and disjoint net fate bridge, full stocks and inherited WIP once, actual whole contaminated exports and non-overlapping provider service demand, separate asset/packaging physical fleets, actual quantities and original cohorts retained.
review.bilingual: Complete EN/ZH meaning and supported source/ancestor units reviewed; typed rules, calculations, quality and twelve-field protocols, source/use and ordered qualifiers compared.
review.remaining_limits: Actual providers, quantities, grades, full applicable site/matrix method qualification and unbound ordinary identities remain explicit study obligations. No generic-category proxy or empirical default; finite checks do not establish scientific approval or complete plant data.
